bugs.description: needFunds uses <= instead of <, so spending an account's exact balance is refused as Insufficient.
The Insufficient refusal reports the shortfall with the operands swapped, so it reports a negative short.
move refuses an amount of 0 even though it is documented as allowed, which breaks zero-fee captures, zero-part splits and zero tips.
Off-by-one in the capture fee threshold: an amount of exactly 100 skips the house fee.
Wrong variable in capture: the fee is paid to the seller instead of the house.
The Captured audit event records the amount net of the fee instead of the gross amount captured.
bugs.new: { kind: "Captured", seller, amount: amount - fee, at: c.now }

bugs.description: purchase treats an escrow balance of exactly 0 as Overdrawn, so purchases into an empty escrow are refused.
refund accepts part = 0 instead of refusing it with BadPart, and then captures the whole amount for the seller.
cancel emits Cancelled before the release, so the audit log has the events in the wrong order (Cancelled before Moved and Released).
bugs.old:
release(c, escrow, buyer, amount);
  c.audit.emit({ kind: "Cancelled", buyer, at: c.now });
bugs.new:
c.audit.emit({ kind: "Cancelled", buyer, at: c.now });
  release(c, escrow, buyer, amount);
